rfeExplain.text: What this letter is and who sent itThis is a Request for Evidence (RFE) sent by the U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) Potomac Service Center regarding Form I-765 for NAME 1 under receipt number RECEIPT 1.Why you received itUSCIS is reviewing your application for optional practical training and needs more information because the current evidence is not sufficient to establish eligibility.What it asks forYou must submit:A copy of your Form I-20 endorsed by your Designated School Official within the last 30 days, showing the post-completion OPT recommendation.A copy of your passport biographic page.Two passport-style photographs with your name and A-Number (A NUMBER 1) written lightly on the back.A copy of your marriage certificate for your F-2 dependent spouse, NAME 2.Send this notice along with your response to the address listed in the letter.DeadlineYour response must be received by December 16, 2026.What happens if you do nothingIf USCIS does not receive the requested evidence by December 16, 2026, they will decide your application based on the existing record, and it may be denied.Please check anything about your immigration status with your school's international student office or a qualified immigration attorney.
